subject.title: [Feature]: Configurable memory recall eligibility and index exclusion paths for markdown-first workspaces

question: Should memory-core grow a configurable include/exclude path-scope contract for both builtin Memory Search indexing and short-term promotion, or should markdown-first scope control remain a QMD/custom memory plugin pattern?
rationale: The request is valid from source inspection, but it adds compatibility-sensitive configuration and affects memory plugin ownership, index identity, diagnostics, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Add a narrow memory-core path-scope contract
options.body: Design one plugin-owned include/exclude evaluator that defaults to current behavior and is shared by indexing, watch/sync diagnostics, and short-term promotion eligibility.

options.title: Route advanced scope control to QMD/custom memory plugins
options.body: Keep builtin memory-core simple and document how markdown-first users can use QMD collections or a custom memory plugin for specialized corpus policy.

options.title: Defer until memory default convergence
options.body: Leave this open as a product-direction item until maintainers decide the recommended memory backend path.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow memory-core path-scope contract
recommendation.body: Design one plugin-owned include/exclude evaluator that defaults to current behavior and is shared by indexing, watch/sync diagnostics, and short-term promotion eligibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has recent history on memory config docs, QMD extra collections, and memory host cleanup, which is closest to this product/config choice.
